description: Membership warehouse club selling groceries and household goods in bulk at thin markups, with gas, pharmacy, and e-commerce.

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-09-24 (Thursday, after the close), 5 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 6.55.
catalyst.why: 2026-09-24 report must show e-commerce growth near 20.9% and stable renewal rates, proving the 18% pullback is overdone.

reasons: August net sales rose 9.9% to $23.70B and e-commerce grew 17.9% in August, yet shares sit 18% below May peak—growth has not slowed.
EPS revisions are tilted higher (8 up, 4 down over 30 days), and next-FY consensus forward PE is 39.51, below the current 43.54, so the market is paying less for next year's earnings.
Costco's membership model converts e-commerce growth into recurring fee income, so 20.9% fiscal e-commerce growth feeds renewal rates and margin expansion.

quants.eps_revisions: tilted higher, with 8 up and 4 down over last 30 days
extra: Last quarter cash and cash equivalents increasing 9% quarter over quarter (5/10/2026)
Last quarter earnings before interest and tax increasing 8% quarter over quarter (5/10/2026)

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-12-18 report, with the long leg expiring 2027-01-15, which gives the thesis time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The 24.4% conservative credit clears the floor, but the short October call caps upside into the catalyst. Net debit $2,660 is modest; if the report disappoints, the long-dated call still holds value.
